event.description: Content hash of canonical body; also the filename and idempotency key

path.description: For stale-claim events from obsolescence sweeps

orphaned.description: True when the referenced SHA was rebased away; event is retained

severity.description: Numeric mapping of anchored ordinal: grazes|bends|breach|entrenches

precision_at.description: Assertion precision frozen at observation time

rationale.description: Blob ref (sha256:…) to full rationale text; violations only

supersedes.description: Event id this ruling supersedes; fold takes the tip of each chain

dispersion_snapshot.description: Present only on firing events: author_entropy, path_entropy, time_spread, compliance_ratio
